source.notes: ICSE 2025 board examination paper (code 'T25 511' printed on every page) from the official CISCE Archive Library bundle 'ICSE-MainExamination2025.zip' (session 'Main examination' taken from the bundle name). No official marking scheme is published with this paper; questions carry no official answer. Paper prints 'Maximum Marks: 80', 'Time allowed: Three hours' and 'Attempt all questions from Section A and any four questions from Section B.' Section A (40 marks) = Question 1 (fifteen 1-mark MCQ/assertion-reason items, [15] printed for the whole question) + Question 2 (4+4+4) + Question 3 (4+4+5). Section B = Questions 4-10, each 10 marks (3+3+4, except Question 6 = 5+5), candidate attempts any four; all are included, so the marks in this pack add up to 110 rather than 80. No 'OR' alternatives are printed, so choiceGroup is null throughout; each (i)/(ii)/(iii) sub-part is its own entry and its (a)/(b)/(c) items are kept together. IMPORTANT: the text layer of every equation (equation-editor font) is corrupt: math-italic letters and digits come out doubled, multi-letter runs (sin, cos, cot, sec, cosec and the words of the Reason in 1(xv)) collapse to one repeated character, and matrix brackets and stacked fractions lose their layout. Prose was taken from the text layer; every mathematical expression was transcribed from pages rendered with pdfplumber and checked visually (zoomed crops for 1(i), 3(ii), 4(i)); such items are MEDIUM and flagged. Fractions are written inline (a/b), powers as Unicode superscripts, matrices row by row as [[row 1], [row 2]], tables as '|'-separated rows. Items that depend on a diagram or graph for data are LOW. No cognitive-level tags are printed on this paper.
